topics.title: Coursework & Assessment
topics.summary: The Faculty of Economics says AI tools are permitted by default and supports their effective, ethical and transparent use. University-wide default permission is not established by this excerpt.

additionalTopics.title: Academic Integrity
additionalTopics.summary: Regulations require that automated AI detection results cannot serve as the sole ground for academic dishonesty findings, requiring substantive instructor evaluation; formal disciplinary appeal procedures remain an unverified gap.

claims.text: Automated AI detector results cannot serve as the sole basis for academic dishonesty findings, requiring substantive instructor expert evaluation; formal appeal procedures remain an unverified gap.

evidence.quote:

исключительно автоматической проверки и всегда является результатом экспертной
